title: Double-ended Eyeshadow Blending Brush
body_html:
1. Double head size with dual brush heads, apply color and blend details with one brush to complete eye makeup
2. High density soft fiber hair, soft and non irritating around the eyes, evenly grabbing powder with little fly powder
3. Clear division of labor for size brush heads, large area base+transition of eye socket details
4. Light luxury metal brush handle, extended anti slip grip, easy for beginners to control
5. Dry and wet dual-use eye shadow powder/cream, necessary for eye makeup to reduce swelling
6. Independently hanging dust-proof packaging, clean and portable, carry it with you when going out for makeup repair“
